_comment: NJAC Vision. Only entries in 'videos' are rendered on the site. 'pending' is a staging list that the page ignores - videos collected and verified but not yet published. Move entries from 'pending' to 'videos' to make them go live. 'id' is the YouTube video id: the part after youtube.com/watch?v= , /live/ or /embed/ . Thumbnail and player are derived from it, so no image files are needed. Order is the order shown on the page.
